content_blocks.label: clause_1._NOTICE_OF_EVICTION
content_blocks.text: You are hereby notified that you are in default of the lease agreement for the premises at 456 Oak Avenue, Hilltop City, State of Novacorp.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_REASON_FOR_EVICTION
content_blocks.text: You have failed to pay the rent in full within five days of the due date, which constitutes a material breach of the lease agreement.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._ACTION_REQUIRED
content_blocks.text: You must vacate the premises on or before July 15, 2024, or face legal action.
